items.name: 1. Spec Compliance
items.note: All four requested behaviours exist (task box + Resolve + In progress tile, reason popup, req3-campaign/operator help, generated help doc); nothing beyond them.

items.name: 2. Error Handling
items.note: Malformed fixNowForTriageId is dropped on create and on load; Dismiss popover keeps itself open when the dismiss fails; launch_failed releases the link.

items.name: 3. Security Basics
items.note: New field is regex-validated (trg-8hex) server side, rendered as text only; promotedFromTriageId stays daemon-owned and refused on the public route.

items.name: 4. Test Quality
items.note: Server round-trip + client unit + component + 3 real-browser E2E tests cover happy and error paths including project mismatch and launch_failed.

items.name: 5. Performance Basics
items.note: Card readers share the Board's cached task-list query with refetchOnMount off; only the page polls (5s).

items.name: 6. Naming & Structure
items.note: New files are small and grouped under triage/, lib/, hooks/; store file held at its 591-line baseline by extracting task-triage-link.ts.

items.name: 7. Affected Boundaries
items.note: sdk-sessions.json producer (create route) and consumer (loader/validate) pair covered by a store-and-reload test; additive field, write-on-touch.

items.name: 8. Test Hygiene Probe
items.note: No skipped, focused or quarantined tests added.
